title: A limb can regrow
hook: Some animals can replace a lost structure.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The two silhouettes represent a limb before and after a regrowth interval. Many salamanders can regenerate limbs, but this schematic does not show the cellular steps, the time required, or the outcome for every injured individual.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A salamander loses a limb. What later outcome is possible in some salamanders?
